001: Lucas, the system gave an error and I lost the report I was editing.
Calm down, Fernanda. Did you manage to save any version before the problem?
I don't think so, and that's making me really worried.
Let me check the version history for you. Maybe we can still recover it.
Wow, what a relief! If you can do it, I'll buy you a coffee.
Don't worry, that's what teamwork is for.
002: The client complained that the product arrived with a missing piece.
I see. Did you check if it was a mistake in shipping or in assembly?
Not yet, but I think the problem might have happened during packing.
I'll talk to the warehouse staff now to look into this.
Good idea. And I'll call the client myself to explain the situation.
Perfect. That way we can solve this before the end of the day.
003: Rafael, I can't access the project's shared folder.
That's strange, because I just accessed it from here. Are you using the new link?
I don't think so. It must be the old link that got saved in my browser.
I'll send you the updated link now. Try again in a little while.
It worked! Thank you so much, you saved me.
No problem, just let me know if anything comes up.
004: The supplier delayed the delivery and now we're out of material for the meeting.
That's a serious problem. Have you contacted them yet?
Yes, and they said the order goes out tonight.
Then we need a plan B for tomorrow's presentation.
I agree. I can prepare a summarized version with what we already have.
Great, let's do that. That way we won't be left empty-handed.
005: Beatriz, the client requested a last-minute change to the contract.
Really? That could delay our entire schedule.
Yeah, but I think the change is small and we can adjust it.
Then send me the details by email and I'll review them now.
I already sent it. Take a look when you can, please.
Perfect, I'll prioritize this. Thanks for letting me know.
006: The building's elevator broke down and we're on the tenth floor.
What an annoying situation! Did you notify the front desk yet?
Not yet, I called you first to know what to do.
I'll call them now and then I'll walk up the stairs to meet you.
You're an angel, Gabriel. I'll wait here in the office.
Don't worry, we'll figure this out together.
007: Camila, the survey results don't match what we expected.
Hmm, that's concerning. Did you review the methodology we used?
I did, but maybe the sample was too small.
That makes sense. We can expand the data collection to confirm.
Good idea. I'll prepare a new questionnaire today.
Perfect. If you need help, just call me.
008: The client didn't respond to our email and the proposal is about to expire.
That's tricky. Did you try calling him?
Not yet, but I think it would be better to talk by phone anyway.
I agree. Call him now, and if you need to, I'll join the conversation.
Thanks, Rafael. I'll try in a little while.
Good luck! Let me know if anything comes up.
009: The file you sent me won't open on my computer.
That's weird. Did you download the latest version of the program?
I think so, but it might be outdated.
I'll send you the file in another format to test it.
Perfect, thanks. If it works, we'll go with that one.
Sounds good. Let me know if it works out.
010: The meeting was rescheduled for tomorrow morning and I don't have the material ready.
Calm down, we can figure this out. What exactly is missing?
I just need to review the numbers and put together the final slides.
Then let's split the tasks: I'll review the data and you put together the slides.
Deal! With that, we'll finish everything by the end of the afternoon.
